failure_summary.description: A result-producing search or filter was left unsaved, or cache retrieval was nested inside another tool call.
Agents skipped an unmet follow-up, accepted offer, new constraint, or independent requested domain despite relevant conversation and cache context.
Agents invoked proximity search for an area preference or used stale inputs instead of applying the new domain filter first.
Agents inferred an unrequested amenity or hotel stay length, or repeated already-completed work.

patch.reasoning: Most observed failures already contradict explicit rules in the skill, so repeating them would not patch a gap. The travel-date guidance does not explicitly cover alternative trip start dates with one shared return date; clarifying how to map that itinerary to hotel dates addresses the distinct unsupported checkout inference in the batch.

edits.target: When lodging is requested for an explicitly planned trip and both trip dates are known, use the trip start and end dates as hotel check-in and check-out.
edits.content: When a hotel trip has multiple alternative start dates and one shared, explicit return or end date, use the alternative starts as check-in candidates and the shared end date as checkout. Do not calculate separate checkout dates or infer a stay length from flight timing; seek the checkout date if the itinerary does not establish it.
